legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising out of or related to this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
